================================================================================
   🚀 NEXT STEPS FOR NEW RASPBERRY PI
================================================================================

OPTION A: Using USB Backup (Recommended for offline transfer)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
1. Take the Lexar USB stick to your new Raspberry Pi
2. Plug it in and copy the backup folder:
   cp -r /media/pi/Lexar/RDK_Device_Manager_Backup_* ~/
3. Navigate to the folder:
   cd ~/RDK_Device_Manager_Backup_*
4. Run the installer:
   chmod +x install_complete_system.sh
   ./install_complete_system.sh
5. Deploy application files:
   cp -r app/* ./
   cp config/* ./
   cp data/* ./
6. Start the application:
   source venv/bin/activate
   python3 app.py

Total time: ~10 minutes


OPTION B: Using Git (If you push to GitHub/GitLab)
──────────────────────────────────────────────────
1. Create private repository on GitHub/GitLab
2. Push from current Pi:
   git remote add origin https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/RDK-Device-Manager.git
   git push -u origin main
3. On new Pi, clone:
   git clone https://github.com/YOUR_USERNAME/RDK-Device-Manager.git
   cd RDK-Device-Manager
4. Run installer:
   ./install_complete_system.sh
5. Copy sensitive data files manually (devices.json, users.json)
6. Start application:
   source venv/bin/activate
   python3 app.py

Total time: ~10 minutes

================================================================================
   💻 APPLICATION DETAILS
================================================================================

Project: RDK Device Manager
Type: Flask Web Application
Version: 1.0.0
Python: 3.7+
Default Port: 5000 (HTTP), 5443 (HTTPS)
SSH Port: 10022

Key Features:
   ✅ SSH-based device control
   ✅ Real-time log streaming
   ✅ Screenshot capture & comparison
   ✅ AI-powered screen validation
   ✅ Test sequence automation
   ✅ Job queue management
   ✅ User authentication
   ✅ IR blaster integration
   ✅ Multi-device parallel testing
   ✅ Historical result tracking

Python Dependencies:
   - Flask 3.0.0
   - Flask-Login 0.6.3
   - Flask-Bcrypt 1.0.1
   - Paramiko 3.4.0
   - Pillow 10.1.0
   - pytesseract 0.3.10
   - requests 2.31.0
   - gunicorn 21.2.0
   - gevent 24.2.1

System Dependencies:
   - Python 3
   - Tesseract OCR
   - Image libraries (libjpeg, libpng, zlib)
   - OpenSSL
   - Git (optional)
